dct_description_sm: The Belcher Glacier is a marine terminating glacier with a tidewater margin nearly 7 km wide.  In the lower 11 km of this 50 km long glacier, the glacier bed lies below sea level in an over-deepened fjord channel.  Since the goal of the Canadian Glaciodyn project is to develop and validate a high-resolution model of this glacial system, seabed mapping off the terminus of the Belcher Glacier is an important part of constraining both the model geometry and the ice marginal advance history.
dct_title_s: Glaciodyn (Canada) IPY Project: Belcher Glacier seabed mapping data
